title: Lower MATRIX_LR (Muon) 0.04 -> 0.03
description: Changed MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 on top of the current baseline (ASPECT_RATIO=96, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18, DEPTH=8); no other changes.
reflection: val_bpb 0.982590 vs baseline 0.982558 -- a no-op, within noise (0.003% difference, smaller than the ~0.02% spread seen in prior duplicate runs). MATRIX_LR=0.04 appears already well-tuned at the current model width/step-count; this axis is not where further gains live. Avoided the crowded TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^17 duplicate (proposed by both a0 and a4) and the 3-way weight-decay cluster (a1/a2/a5) by picking the one genuinely unique, low-duplication-risk proposal on the table. Suggest next round someone tries MATRIX_LR in the other direction (e.g. 0.05-0.06) only if there's a specific reason to think this axis matters -- otherwise it looks closed. Weight-decay and the step-count-push-further experiments still need real data.
